1.consolidated_definition: De rechupete. “Bístase en un periquete, —monte al anca a ña Pilal, —y bamos pal Guayabal, —que aqueyo está de jinquete. —Un baile que no es juguete —tienen ayí preparao.” Virgilio Dávila, .
1.en_consolidated_definition: De rechupete: "Rides on a horse at full gallop to ña Pilal's back, and we head to Guayabal, where they are preparing for a dance that is no joke."
